# PCB Designer v3.0.0

This release turns the skill from a documentation package into an executable
hardware-design workflow.

## Highlights

- **11 deterministic calculators** for trace width, via current, microstrip,
  stripline, differential microstrip, LDO thermal margin, battery life, buck
  inductors, RC filters, voltage dividers, and CSV power budgets.
- **Fabrication release auditor** for Gerber/drill presence, BOM/CPL schema,
  designator consistency, DNP handling, and common package failures.
- **Skill package validator** plus CI on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
- **Progressive-disclosure references** for intake, schematic review, stackup,
  release, bring-up, high reliability, and standards.
- **Templates** for design briefs, review reports, fabrication checkout,
  supplier RFQs, power budgets, and bring-up logs.
- **12 realistic evals** covering design, calculation, review, safety,
  release, debugging, and contribution behavior.
- **Chinese README** and broader Codex/Claude/Agent Skills compatibility.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/SPREsxm/claude-pcb-designer.git
cd claude-pcb-designer
python scripts/install.py --target codex --force
```

Use `--target claude` or `--target agents` for other runtimes.

## Safety

This release is engineering assistance, not a certification or a replacement
for qualified review in mains, high-voltage, battery, RF, medical, automotive,
aviation, or space applications.

## Validation

```bash
python scripts/validate_skill.py .
mypy scripts tests --ignore-missing-imports
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python scripts/package_skill.py
```

Full changes are in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SPREsxm/claude-pcb-designer/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md).
